Here is the recap of your X campaign for **The Lantern in the Snow** drawing contest (`https://nuzzlesprigbooks.com/draw`), which ran across all eight days from **Wednesday, November 25, 2026 (00:00 EST / 05:00 UTC) through Wednesday, December 2, 2026 (24:00 EST / Dec 3 05:00 UTC)**. All campaigns and ad groups are now paused and completed.

### Overall Campaign Totals
* **Total Spend:** **$745.45 USD** (`745,445,905` micro USD out of the $750.00 budget)
* **Impressions:** **522,957**
* **Link Clicks:** **244**
* **Completed Entries ("Drawing entered" pixel conversions):** **40** (30 post-engagement, 10 post-view)
* **Total Engagements:** **3,670**

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)
All ad groups strictly targeted residents of the **United States and Canada aged 21+** (`AGE_OVER_21`) and optimized for website conversions using your **"Drawing entered"** (`41w6h`) pixel tag.

| Ad Group | Targeting Focus | Status | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Completed Entries | Cost / Entry |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **AG1 (`290t7`)** | Art, Design, Animation & Family, Anime interests | Completed | $341.70 | 251,973 | 91 | 18 | $18.98 |
| **AG2 (`z8k0a`)** | Drawing/Illustration/Picture Book keywords + `@NuzzlesprigBook` followers & lookalikes | Completed | $313.84 | 206,303 | 128 | 19 | $16.52 |
| **AG3 (`3n57x`)** | Family, Parenting & Education interests | Paused Dec 1 | $89.90 | 64,681 | 25 | 3 | $29.97 |
| **Total** | | | **$745.45** | **522,957** | **244** | **40** | **$18.64** |

---

### Creative Selection & Optimization Highlights
* **Posts Promoted:** We promoted the three contest-specific posts (`2123642491501722570`, `2123823685434688529`, and `2124004879365323099`) and excluded the generic studio update (`2124186073300227528`) so that every impression clearly communicated the drawing contest and entry rules.
* **Top-Performing Creative:** Post `2123823685434688529` (*"Imagine giving a Christmas book with your drawing inside..."*) drove the highest click-through rate and conversion volume, generating **113 link clicks** across all ad groups.
* **Budget Reallocation:** As flight data accumulated, **AG2** (Keywords + Follower Lookalikes) and **AG1** (Art & Illustration Interests) proved far more efficient at generating completed drawing entries ($16.52 and $18.98 per entry, respectively) than **AG3** (Family & Parenting, $29.97 per entry). We progressively shifted daily budget from AG3 into AG1 and AG2, and paused AG3 after Day 6 to maximize entries during the final two days while staying within your $750.00 total budget.
